name: DoReMi Pizzeria
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to DoReMi Pizzeria in Tirol!**

Indulge in authentic Italian flavors right in the heart of the **Alps**. Our wood-fired pizzas are crafted with fresh, local ingredients—from crispy **Tiroler** potatoes to creamy **Käse** from the region. Whether you crave a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a sweet **Pizza Dolce** with **Apfelmus**, every bite is a taste of Italy with a **Tirol** twist.

After your meal, warm up with a **Kaiserschmarrn** or a **Apfelstrudel**—perfect for sharing with friends or enjoying alone. Our cozy atmosphere, paired with a view of the **Innsbruck** skyline, makes every visit unforgettable.

**DoReMi Pizzeria**—where **Tirol** meets **Dolce Vita**! 🍕✨

---
*(Open daily—come for the pizza, stay for the vibes!)*
